response.overview: The Blue Guardian and the Red Guardian will face their past and a powerful villain named Black Mist. Tracking a potent energy and seeking revenge, Black Mist encounters his former partner, Carlos Almeida (the Blue Guardian); they engage in a brutal fight, during which Anne Santos (the Red Guardian) joins the battle and discovers a secret capable of shaking their world to its core.
response.title: Guardiões do Poder
